value.rationale: A natural complete finite-dimensional description of the least-gap multiplicity hierarchy, exposing positive coalescence atoms and a uniformly random defect mark independent of stopping location. Single-rank Rayleigh moments do not describe these dependencies; the \(r/s\) coalescence and record-minima coupling are intrinsic structural laws useful for joint statistics.
